    e.type
FROM
    (SELECT
        link_to_event AS event_id,
        COUNT(link_to_member) AS member_count

JOIN

        type
    FROM
        sqlite_scan('db/event.db', 'event')) AS e
ON
    attendance_filtered.event_id = e.event_id
WHERE
    e.type = 'Meeting';
